pass_a_gloss: Mother encomium: dew of piety; Moses' hymn and Paul's strength in one day.
pass_b_english: What dew of piety fell on that mother, who saw seven sons perfected in one day and stood nobly! 'My strength and my hymn is the Lord, and he is become my salvation.' (Exodus 15:2) And 'I can all things in him who strengtheneth me.' (Philippians 4:13) By divine power she exhorted in a tongue the tyrant understood not, and nursed seven martyrs unto heaven in a single day.
